hooks.text: 本地或在线队友必须在列车持续行驶时协作铺轨，并在程序生成世界中即时处理障碍避免脱轨。
hooks.excerpt: Unrailed 2: Back on Track brings chaotic local and online multiplayer track-building action to the next level – band together with friends to collaborate and build your track across new procedurally generated worlds - WHILST the train is running!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 永久奖励可解锁改变玩法的角色能力，以及新引擎、车厢和扩展件，用于反复试验多种列车配置。
hooks.excerpt: new rewards and permanent upgrades granting you character with gameplay-modifying abilities, as well as new train engines, wagons and extensions to unlock, giving you the tools to build a multitude of train configurations to play and experiment with.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: Terrain Conductor模式允许制作并分享自定义地图，也能直接浏览社区持续产出的关卡。
hooks.excerpt: The all-new Terrain Conductor mode allows you unleash your imagination to create your very own custom maps and share these with the Unrailed community – with highlights being featured by the developers.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
